ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts being made to prevent and prosecute such crimes.
questions: What is the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What steps are being taken to prevent and prosecute Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased oversight and regulation in the Medicaid system.
